checks.name: Anonymous reads/writes return 401 and cross-origin writes return 403
Authenticated editor cannot publish through the API
Client content/snapshot injection and unsaved publish payloads are rejected
Editor saves an additive design; stale revision returns 409 without changes
Saved preview uses the real shared renderer with unchanged heading and product selection order
Saved composition has one H1 and no body overflow at 320, 390, 800 and 1440 px
Later drafts do not change historical preview or public layout; explicit Gujarati preview uses captured review state
Mobile preview loads the exact saved revision in an actual 390 px iframe
Simulated missing saved media reference prevents publication atomically
Simulated changed homepage fingerprint prevents publishing a stale captured design
History failure rolls back both draft and publication writes without changing the saved row
Cancelled unsaved Studio navigation retains all design choices
Lost post-save response keeps edits; latest comparison safely reconciles the committed revision
Browser saves and previews the exact revision, publishes it, and confirms actual public revision and unchanged selections
Revision recovery creates a new draft while leaving the public composition unchanged
History list is bounded and Studio editor fits a 390 px viewport
No browser runtime errors or protected content changes
